title: RBI notifies amended ECB framework, replaces cap with higher of $1B or 300% net worth
summary: RBI notified FEMA Borrowing & Lending First Amendment Regulations 2026: Automatic ECB limit raised from $750M to higher of $1B or 300% net worth; minimum 3-year maturity; acquisition of control permitted.
